comparison.objective: Dry all layers of long articulated hair evenly with a handheld dryer while the mannequin head remains fixed; candidate performs rigid-body media/workpiece separation with a manual screen.
comparison.physical_skill: Airflow positioning, thermal/moisture exposure, occlusion management, flexible-lock manipulation, and dryer operation versus bimanual rigid-screen load sharing, agitation, aperture passage, retention, and reseating.
comparison.success_condition: Record requires every one of 960 patches to retain at most 10% initial water, temperature ≤50°C, fixed-head tolerances, intact attached hair, dryer off/parked, hands clear, and a 1 s hold; candidate requires ≥98% recovered rigid media, both washers retained, screen supported, and 3 s dwell. Some model calibration remains explicitly missing, but the tested objective is unambiguously unrelated.
comparison.reason: This is deformable thermal drying and hidden-layer exposure, whereas the candidate is rigid many-body mechanical sieving; generic tool holding or bimanual manipulation does not create overlap.
